title: English Practice Quiz 0607
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.
